description: Real estate and property listing search API for AI agents: Zillow search URLs return JSON zillow_data with prices, addresses, beds, baths and listing links, plus coordinates and Zestimate when available. Supports US housing research without generic page scraping. Price: 5 prepaid credits per successful call. MCP returns a compact view of these results.

results.description: Maximum number of listings to return.

url.description: Zillow search URL, for example https://www.zillow.com/homes/Austin,-TX_rb/ (short forms like https://www.zillow.com/austin-tx/ are converted).

name: search_zillow
title: Search Zillow
